title: Lexical and semantic components
local_result: Exact and LCS components, pinned local MiniLM, and fragment scoring are implemented. Ten saved real traces support repeated prefix scoring.
limits: Unicode matching, token truncation, three-sentence chunks with one-sentence overlap, and encoded-span coverage are disclosed implementation choices. Component consistency does not establish semantic attribution accuracy.

title: Online observation contract
local_result: A detached sidecar records each proposal before native tool runtime. Fixed-response controls preserve outbound requests, actions, history and environment, including error paths.
limits: This pre-runtime online contract is a local adaptation. Computation is synchronous and has no hard analysis deadline; logs do not reveal hidden model reasoning or internal causal dependencies.

title: Real-agent recording consistency
local_result: Real Groq execution has proposal-time receipts and exact saved-prefix replay. The latest ten-run calendar batch passes 300/300 consistency checks across 20 executed proposals and 50 argument fields.
limits: This establishes the tested recording and replay contract, not source correctness, maliciousness or a causal overhead estimate. Standalone recorder overhead is unavailable.

title: Source/sink policy and ordered stages
local_result: A fixed workspace policy routes each eligible source and selected leaf argument through the cascade. Ordinary thresholds and the restored-memory semantic threshold are implemented; each skipped or unavailable stage remains explicit.
limits: Source eligibility, per-leaf comparison and stopping choices are local. Scenario-specific implicit-string and safe-control threshold profiles are absent. In all three repeated evaluation batches every observed first hit is Tier2; these trials do not exercise later-stage effectiveness.

title: DCPG and memory restoration
local_result: A private lineage checkpoint and exact native cloud-drive adapter preserve candidate ancestry. A two-session native control restores stored content and lineage; saved traces repeat exactly.
limits: Coverage is limited to the tested file adapter and namespace. Real-model cross-session efficacy is unvalidated. The selected live task32 failed at provider validation after search/create; its two executed proposals remain verified. Native query restarts retire active memory bindings and do not prove an environment reset.

title: Separate Canary condition
local_result: UUID assignment, actual publication/exposure, controlled sink carryover and cross-session restoration are implemented. A fresh task29 comparison has five passive and five Canary injected runs, all completed.
limits: This condition changes model-visible source text. No Tier1 sink hit or primary outcome advantage appears in that comparison. The earlier two task31 provider failures are retained. A missing canary does not rule out influence.

title: Isolated A/B auditor
local_result: Source neutralization and a deferred no-tools A/B judge operate on saved proposal-time prefixes. Seven native controls pass 37/37 checks; two separate Groq auditor requests produce valid predictions without changing primary records.
limits: Auditor predictions are not observed counterfactual agent reruns. The local neutralization and conservative trigger are one interpretation. Joint/conjunctive-cause detection is not implemented; independent causal accuracy remains unknown. Zero auditor requests in later batches mean ineligibility, not a negative causal result.

title: Independent attribution evaluation
local_result: Three distinct ten-slot native batches, saved-prefix ablations, lexical diagnostics and assisted development labels are complete. Native task outcomes and actual payload exposure have valid separate denominators.
limits: Independent source-field references, second review/adjudication and independent scoring are pending. Precision, recall and F1 are null. Native utility and attack goals do not label attribution. Original result tables, external benchmark coverage, unseen-tool/attack robustness and defense benefit are not reproduced.
